name: list_services
description: IT services אקווה פלו offers to businesses, each with a summary and the page URL.

name: search_site
description: Search Hebrew guides and pages on iip.co.il. Accepts Hebrew or English keywords. Returns titles, URLs and summaries.

name: get_contact_details
description: Phone, email, office hours and contact page of אקווה פלו.

name: send_contact_request
description: Send a contact or quote request to אקווה פלו. Call only after the person explicitly agreed to share name, email and phone; set consent to true.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services, search_site, get_contact_details · Private data: get_company_info, get_contact_details, send_contact_request · Public sink: get_contact_details, send_contact_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services, search_site, get_contact_details · Private data: get_company_info, get_contact_details, send_contact_request · Public sink: get_contact_details, send_contact_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
